notes.title: Privacy Policy Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34953556/f39c474ec1815fa361cbc9bbb3b47fd93965ba96.jpg[/img]


Long story short - we're streamlining our operation, legally speaking, from our end and we had to add Acram Digital Sp. z o.o. (which would translate to Acram Digital Ltd.) to our privacy policy.

Once you launch the game, once the update goes through that is, you'll be faced with a pop-up message about just that. If you continue past that message you will have conceded to our new updated Privacy Policy. 

But as I have mentioned, nothing apart from this addition has changed in it, so do not worry! 

Should you be interested, you can read our Privacy Policy [url=https://acram.eu/privacy-policy/][b]HERE[/b][/url].
